 What You Will Experience In This Position
Design, maintain and continuously improve transportation dashboards, reports, and analytical tools to support business decisions.
Analyze transportation data, identify discrepancies and collaborate with stakeholders to improve data quality and reporting accuracy.
Develop and maintain standardized, scalable tools related to transportation network management and logistics processes.
Act as the main point of contact for selected Outside the Region Intercompany customers and designated transportation service providers.
Support transportation operations through administrative activities related to freight planning and execution.
Assist with freight spend analysis, cost tracking, and identification of optimization opportunities.
Participate in transportation-related projects aimed at improving efficiency, service performance, and data visibility.
Contribute actively to daily, weekly, and monthly team meetings, sharing insights and progress updates.
 You Have
University student or recent graduate in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills and an interest in data-driven decision making.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experience with reporting and data visualization tools is an advantage.
Good English communication skills, both written and verbal; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to prioritize tasks, self-organize, and work effectively in a dynamic environment.
Curiosity and willingness to leverage AI and digital tools to improve productivity and insights.
 WE HAVE
 A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day
nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nVent.com.
